config.label: Your Phototology API key (pt_live_
config.description: Your Phototology API key (pt_live_... for production, pt_test_... for the free fixture sandbox). Get one at https://phototology.com/dashboard. New accounts include 1,000 free credits on email verification.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.phototology.com. Used for local development against phototology-api.

config.label: Set to 1 to disable anonymous telemetry: the editor name and version, the package version, and per tool call the tool name, success, duration, error code and counts
config.description: Set to 1 to disable anonymous telemetry: the editor name and version, the package version, and per tool call the tool name, success, duration, error code and counts. Never image content, file paths, tool inputs or outputs, or conversation text.

config.label: Set to 1 to disable telemetry
config.description: Set to 1 to disable telemetry. Same effect as PHOTOTOLOGY_MCP_NO_TELEMETRY; follows the cross-tool convention many CLIs honor.

config.label: Folders the server may read photos from and write enriched copies to, separated by : (; on Windows)
config.description: Folders the server may read photos from and write enriched copies to, separated by : (; on Windows). Unset means any local path. Paths are checked after symlinks are resolved.
